title: Eggplant Arrabbiata Pappardelle
subtitle: with olives, capers and feta
description: Pappardelle in a spicy arrabbiata-style sauce of roasted eggplant, tomatoes, olives and capers, topped with feta and basil.

steps.text: Cook the pasta according to the packet instructions and drain, keeping a little of the cooking water.
Roast the diced eggplant in the oven with a little olive oil. Blanch the tomatoes, peel and crush them.

Heat the 1/2 cup olive oil in a wide frying pan and saute the sliced onion until translucent. Add the sliced garlic and stir for about 1 minute. Add the eggplant, chopped chilli, chopped olives and capers, saute briefly, add the tomatoes and cook for about 5 minutes.
Add the pasta with a little of the cooking water and the chopped parsley. Season with salt, transfer to serving plates and top with crumbled feta and torn basil leaves.
